alex.sre: Heads-up: we're scheduling a Redis cluster growth + reshard simulation on Wed 2026-04-01 02:00-04:00 UTC. Goal: validate cluster scaling, eviction behavior, and client backoff under shard growth/resharding. Expected: brief p99 latency blips for internal services, potential throttles for low-priority batch jobs. No planned customer outage. Playbook: https://redwood.internal/runbooks/redis-reshard-sim
rita.platform: Which clusters are in scope? canary vs prod?
alex.sre: Canary first: redis-cache-canary in us-west-1, then us-west-1/redis-main will see simulated shard additions. We'll ramp traffic and abort on SLO breach. Oncall: @sam-oncall can you ack and monitor?
sam-oncall: Acked. I'll watch p95/p99, evictions, and client retry rates. I set a watch window 01:50-04:10 UTC.
maya.sre: Quick checklist: ensure prefix caching turned on for inference routing, disable expensive background compactions, and confirm KV warmup scripts are off during the run. Also coordinate with data-team batch windows.
alex.sre: Good call. Checklist items completed: prefix-cache = enabled, warmup disabled, batch-jobs drained from 01:30-05:00. Abort criteria: evictions > 50/s for > 60s OR inference p99 > 300ms for > 2m. Rollback steps include cancelling the reshard job and restoring previous slot assignments. Abort command (ops shell):
```
# cancel job and pin cluster to previous slot map
redis-ops cancel job-redis-reshard-1766001122 --force
redis-ops pin-slotmap redis-main --from-backup /backups/redis-main-slotmap-20260331
```
deploy-bot: scheduled job created: job-redis-reshard-1766001122 (canary start 2026-04-01T02:00Z)
rita.platform: Do we need a customer-facing notice?
alex.sre: Not planned. Impact should be internal-only. If we see sustained evictions or errors hitting customer-facing endpoints, we'll notify support leads and post an incident banner.
sam-oncall: Adding alert thresholds to monitoring: evictions_rate > 50/s (alert), inference_p99 > 300ms (alert). If either fires, I'll call abort and page the team.
alex.sre: We'll stream logs to #eng-oncall and the reshard runbook will get updated live. Post-run: I'll post a short summary with key metrics, any config changes, and follow-up action items. Post-mortem only if we abort or customer-visible regressions occur.
maya.sre: :thumbsup: Thanks everyone, I'll stand by for the canary start and help verify KV metrics during ramp.
